organization.name: UC Irvine Applied AI & Decision Systems Group
organization.operating_environment: Unclassified research environment with capability to simulate government proposal workflows using publicly available BAAs and RFPs
organization.organizational_maturity: Prototype-to-pilot stage; prior experience delivering research prototypes to government stakeholders

focus_areas: Large language models for structured document synthesis
Natural language understanding of technical solicitations
research_profile.prior_experience: The group has developed multiple prototype systems focused on AI-assisted document analysis and generation, including tools for parsing regulatory documents, extracting structured requirements, and generating structured outputs. Prior work includes collaboration with academic and public-sector stakeholders on decision-support interfaces.
key_capabilities: Evaluation of AI system reliability and trust

representative_projects.name: AI-Assisted Document Structuring Tool
representative_projects.description: System for parsing long-form PDFs into structured sections with semantic tagging
representative_projects.outcome: Reduced manual document review time by ~40% in controlled evaluations

representative_projects.name: Interactive Proposal Drafting Interface
representative_projects.description: Prototype interface for generating structured responses to mock BAAs
representative_projects.outcome: Demonstrated feasibility of LLM-assisted drafting with human oversight

system_architecture.frontend: Next.js web application with structured dashboard interface
system_architecture.backend: Serverless API routes with LLM orchestration
system_architecture.database: Supabase (PostgreSQL) for user data and proposal storage

core_pipeline: Parse and segment document into semantic sections
Extract key requirements and evaluation criteria
Expand into full draft with section-level generation

infrastructure_and_data.data_handling: No classified or export-controlled data is used; all processing occurs on unclassified inputs

breakdown.notes: LLM usage, vector storage, compute scaling

project_goals.primary_objective: Develop an AI-assisted system that enables rapid understanding and structured response generation for government BAAs and RFPs.
technical_goals: Automate requirement extraction from unstructured documents
Generate structured proposal outlines aligned with evaluation criteria
Support iterative human-AI collaboration in drafting
Improve speed and consistency of proposal development
expected_outcomes: Demonstrated time savings in controlled studies
Documentation for transition to operational environments

risk_and_mitigation.mitigation: Introduce validation steps and human review checkpoints
Use structured extraction and traceability mapping

transition_and_impact.transition_path: Pilot deployment within research and contractor environments, followed by integration into internal proposal workflows
transition_and_impact.long_term_vision: Establish AI-assisted proposal generation as a standard capability in government acquisition ecosystems

compliance_and_constraints.ethical_considerations: Ensure transparency of AI-generated content and maintain human oversight
compliance_and_constraints.special_constraints: System limited to unclassified data and research use during initial phases
